codeDiffs.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+await page.goto("http://localhost:8918/analytics_console/houndline/", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+login_field = page.locator("#username")
+if await login_field.is_visible():
+    await login_field.fill(str(houndline_login.username))
+    await page.locator("#password").fill(str(houndline_login.password))
+    await page.locator("button[aria-label=\"Log in\"]").click()
+dashboard_anchor = page.get_by_text("Welcome to APM", exact=False)
+await dashboard_anchor.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=30000)
+dashboard_text = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
+service_rows = await page.locator("text=acme-api").all_text_contents()
+return {
+  "current_url": page.url,
+  "dashboard_text": dashboard_text,
+  "service_rows": service_rows
+}
